jobs.title: Fospha - Product Manager
jobs.description: About Fospha Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what s actually working - across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop - down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha every day to decide where budget should move next. We ve spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we re scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin. The role We re hiring two Product Managers to own major parts of the Fospha platform. You ll decide what gets built and why, get it shipped, and prove it worked for clients. This is a role for a doer. You ll own a significant product area end to end, set its direction, and run several initiatives at once. A delivery manager and engineering lead run day-to-day delivery alongside you, so your time goes on the decisions that matter: which client problem to solve, what it s worth, what to cut, and whether what shipped actually moved the needle. You ll join an established team, supporting our continued transformation in a post-AI era. We re looking for people who will push how we structure and execute to maximise the value of Product work, not take their first step into Product management. What you ll do Own a product area end to end. Take initiatives from problem, sizing and discovery through build, launch and adoption. Make the sequencing calls for your area and run several initiatives in parallel. Start every initiative with why. Before anything is built, be clear on the client problem, the evidence for it, the expected impact for clients, what it s worth commercially, how it fits our pricing and packaging, and how it advances company strategy.
